```{r Read in OHI region boundaries}

```

# STEP 1: CALCULATE CORAL REEF "CURRENT EXTENT" (sources: Allen Coral Atlas [2020], dataMares [2016], Hem / CEDO coral data [2025]) ------------------------------
Extent = Total area from dataMares - area from Allen Coral Atlas, remainder split across all points identified in CEDO data.

```{r Read in Coral Reef extent data sets}
# Read in Allen polygon data (2018-2020):
AllenAtlas_coral_raw <- st_read("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/coral_datasets/Allen_Coral_Atlas/Mexican-Exclusive-Economic-Zone-20230309211010/Reef-Extent/reefextent.gpkg") %>% 
  st_make_valid()

# Read in CEDO point data (2025):
CEDO_coral_raw <- st_read("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/Hem_data/goc_habitat_data/coral/Arrecifes_de_coral_(Golfo_de_California).shp") %>% 
  st_make_valid()

# Total area of corals in the GOC according to dataMares (2016): https://datamares.org/stories/marine-habitat-distributions-in-the-gulf-of-california-2/
CORL_area_dataMares_ha <- 657
```

```{r Match CRS to OHI regions}
# Match CRS to OHI regions
AllenAtlas_coral.data <- st_transform(AllenAtlas_coral_raw, st_crs(ohi_regions))
CEDO_coral.data <- st_transform(CEDO_coral_raw, st_crs(ohi_regions))
```

```{r Clip data to the OHI boundies extent}
# Clip data to the OHI boundies extent
AllenAtlas_coral.data <- st_intersection(AllenAtlas_coral.data, ohi_regions)
CEDO_coral.data   <- st_intersection(CEDO_coral.data, ohi_regions)
```

```{r Identify points from the CEDO data set that do or do not intersect the Allen Atlas polygons}
# Identify points from the CEDO data set that intersect the Allen Atlas polygons
corals_that_intersect <- st_intersects(CEDO_coral.data, AllenAtlas_coral.data)

# Keep only the CEDO points that do NOT intersect Allen Atlas polygons
corals_that_do_not_intersect <- CEDO_coral.data[lengths(corals_that_intersect) == 0,]

# Find how many points don't intersect a polygon:
non_intersect_coral_points <- as.numeric(nrow(corals_that_do_not_intersect))
non_intersect_coral_points
# n = 47 points

```

```{r Convert from m^2 to hectares}
CORL_area_AllenAtlas_m2 <- sum(st_area(AllenAtlas_coral.data))

# Convert m2 to hectares (10000)
CORL_area_AllenAtlas_ha <- as.numeric(CORL_area_AllenAtlas_m2) / 10000
CORL_area_AllenAtlas_ha

```

```{r Find remainder and assign area to non intersecting points}
# Subtract total coral area of CORL_area_AllenAtlas_ha from CORL_area_dataMares_ha
remaining_coral_area_ha <- CORL_area_dataMares_ha - CORL_area_AllenAtlas_ha
remaining_coral_area_ha

# Find how much area each remaning points should be assigned
area_per_point_ha = remaining_coral_area_ha / non_intersect_coral_points
area_per_point_ha

# NOTE TO SELF: 2.59, slightly different than Austin's 2.7 because of a CRS matching change. - Oct 7 2026
```

```{r Construct COMBINED coral reef dataset}

# Rename AllenAtlas_coral.data$geom and drop unwanted columns:
AllenAtlas_coral.data <- AllenAtlas_coral.data %>%
  rename(geometry = geom) %>%
    select(-class)

corals_that_do_not_intersect <- corals_that_do_not_intersect %>%
  select(-Habitat)

# Add an area_ha column for the Allen Atlas polygons and for points that do not intersect:
# But first check the area units:
area <- st_area(AllenAtlas_coral.data$geometry)
units(area)

# Convert the Allen data (given in m2) to hectares (units used by dataMares)
AllenAtlas_coral.data <- AllenAtlas_coral.data %>%
  mutate(area_ha = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 10000)

corals_that_do_not_intersect <- corals_that_do_not_intersect %>%
  mutate(area_ha = area_per_point_ha)

# Bind the two data sets together
COMBINED_coral.data_area <- bind_rows(AllenAtlas_coral.data, corals_that_do_not_intersect)

```

```{r SANITY CHECK on total area}
# Check if it worked: All areas should sum to 657 ha (= dataMares estimate)
sum(COMBINED_coral.data_area$area_ha)
```

```{r Assign CORAL extent to each OHI region}
# Assign the coral extent to each OHI region:
CORL_Current_Extent <- COMBINED_coral.data_area %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    area_ha = sum(area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    year = 2025
  )

all_rgns <- tibble(
  rgn_id = paste0("Region_", 1:9),
  year = 2025
)

CORL_Current_Extent <- all_rgns %>%
  left_join(CORL_Current_Extent, by = c("rgn_id", "year")) %>%
  mutate(area_ha = replace_na(area_ha, 0),
         # Convert hectares to km2
         area_est_2025_km2 = area_ha / 100) %>%
  select(rgn_id, 
         area_est_2025_ha = area_ha,
         area_est_2025_km2,
         year) %>%
  mutate(
    area_est_2025_ha = round(area_est_2025_ha, 2),
    area_est_2025_km2 = round(area_est_2025_km2, 2)
  )

CORL_Current_Extent

```

```{r Ktable of Current Extent}
CORL_Current_Extent %>%
  kable(digits = 4, col.names = c("Region", "Extent (ha) (Allen Atlas data, 2020; CEDO data, 2025; dataMares, 2017)", "Extent(km2)", "Year")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered")) %>%
  add_header_above(
    c('Coral Reef Extent' = 4))

```

## GAPFILL BETWEEN OBSERVED YEARS:
```{r Gapfill CORL_cover_data_rgn}
colnames(CORL_cover_data_rgn)

# First, expand the CORL dataframe to include one row per year per region, even if that region has no data: 
CORL_cover_data_rgn <- CORL_cover_data_rgn %>%
  complete(
    rgn_id = c(paste0("Region_", 1:9)),
    year = full_seq(year, 1)
  )
# 297 obs., 4 vars.

# Keep track of what was originally observed:
CORL_cover_data_rgn<- CORL_cover_data_rgn %>%
  rename(observed_LCC= mean_LCC) %>%
  mutate(
    estimated_LCC = observed_LCC
  )

# Gapfill LCC in missing years using the zoo package:
CORL_cover_data_rgn <- CORL_cover_data_rgn %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  fill(rgn_id, .direction = "downup") %>%
  mutate(

    # Gap-fill missing values
    estimated_LCC = zoo::na.approx(
      estimated_LCC,
      x = year,
      na.rm = FALSE
    ),

    # Classify provenance
    provenance = case_when(
      !is.na(observed_LCC) ~ "observed",
      is.na(observed_LCC) & !is.na(estimated_LCC) ~ "gapfilled",
      is.na(estimated_LCC) ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 297 obs., 6 vars.
```

# DECISION POINT: Select HISTORIC and CONTEMPORARY periods:

```{r Compare observed cover post- and pre- HISTORIC_CUTOFF}
# In other words, do not consider any gapfilled values.

# DECISION POINT: Historic cut off = pre and post 2010
HISTORIC_CUTOFF = 2010

# Distinguish between pre- and post- historic baseline
CORL_Current_Status0 <- CORL_cover_data_rgn %>%
  mutate(
    period = if_else(year < HISTORIC_CUTOFF, "historic", "contemporary")
  )

CORL_Current_Status0 <- CORL_Current_Status0 %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  mutate(
    historic_mean = mean(
      observed_LCC[year < HISTORIC_CUTOFF],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    contemporary_mean = mean(
      observed_LCC[year >= HISTORIC_CUTOFF],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    CORL_current_status = case_when(

      # No historic or contemporary coral observations
      is.nan(historic_mean) & is.nan(contemporary_mean) ~ NA_real_,

      # Historic period
      year < HISTORIC_CUTOFF & is.finite(historic_mean) ~ 100,

      # Contemporary period: calculate relative to historic baseline
      year >= HISTORIC_CUTOFF &
        is.finite(historic_mean) &
        historic_mean > 0 &
        is.finite(contemporary_mean) ~
        pmax(0, pmin((contemporary_mean / historic_mean) * 100, 100)),

      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    observed_LCC = round(observed_LCC, 2),
    estimated_LCC = round(estimated_LCC, 2),
    historic_mean = round(historic_mean, 2),
    contemporary_mean = round(contemporary_mean, 2),
    CORL_current_status = round(CORL_current_status, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    rgn_id,
    year,
    period,
    n_obs,
    observed_LCC,
    estimated_LCC,
    provenance,
    historic_mean,
    contemporary_mean,
    CORL_current_status
  )

# Relevel:
CORL_Current_Status0 <- CORL_Current_Status0 %>%
  mutate(
    period = factor(
      period,
      levels = c("historic", "contemporary")
    ),
    provenance = factor(
      provenance,
      levels = c("observed", "gapfilled")
    )
  )

```

```{r Plot coral cover time}

# Prep for plot:
REGIONS_OF_INTEREST<- c("Region_4", "Region_9")

historic_mean <- unique(CORL_Current_Status0$historic_mean)
contemporary_mean <- unique(CORL_Current_Status0$contemporary_mean)

periods <- CORL_Current_Status0 %>%
  filter(rgn_id %in% REGIONS_OF_INTEREST) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    historic_mean = first(historic_mean),
    contemporary_mean = first(contemporary_mean),
    pre_start = min(year[year < HISTORIC_CUTOFF]),
    post_end = max(year[year >= HISTORIC_CUTOFF]),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot:
CORL_Cover_OverTime<- CORL_Current_Status0 %>%
  filter(rgn_id %in% REGIONS_OF_INTEREST) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(year, observed_LCC, color = period)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~rgn_id) +
  
  # Period means
  geom_segment(
    data = periods,
    aes(x = pre_start, xend = HISTORIC_CUTOFF, 
        y = historic_mean, yend = historic_mean),
    color = "blue", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = periods,
    aes(x = HISTORIC_CUTOFF, xend = post_end, 
        y = contemporary_mean, yend = contemporary_mean),
    color = "orange", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = HISTORIC_CUTOFF,
    color = "gray40",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("historic" = "blue", "contemporary" = "orange")
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 40)) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Historic versus Contemporary Live Coral Cover",
    subtitle = "LCC estimates taken from multiple data sets across sites that were consistently sampled",
    caption = "updated: Nov 6 2026",
    x = "Year",
    y = "% Live Coral Cover (LCC)",
    color = "Period"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )


CORL_Cover_OverTime

```

# STEP 3: FINALIZE CORL_Current_Status DATAFRAME ------------------------------

```{r Merge current extent estimates to CORL_Current_Status0}
colnames(CORL_Current_Status0)
colnames(CORL_Current_Extent)

# Merge:
CORL_Current_Status <- CORL_Current_Status0 %>%
  left_join(select(CORL_Current_Extent,
                   c("rgn_id", "area_est_2025_ha", "area_est_2025_km2")),
            by="rgn_id") %>%
  rename(
    area_est_byMultiScources_ha = area_est_2025_ha,
    area_est_byMultiScources_km2 = area_est_2025_km2
  )

# 297 obs., 12 vars.
  
# Make an include / exclude column based on the information reported by Hem / CEDO:
CORL_Current_Status<- CORL_Current_Status %>%
  mutate(CORL_include_exclude = ifelse(area_est_byMultiScources_ha == 0, "EXCLUDE", 
                                      "INCLUDE"))
# 297 obs., 13 vars.

```

```{r Coral condition map}
# Prepare coral condition data for join
coral_condition_map <- CORL_Current_Status %>%
  filter(year == 2024) %>%
  mutate(
    rgn_id = gsub(" ", "_", rgn_id),
    current_status_int = round(CORL_current_status, 0),

    # Categorize into meaningful bins
    status_cat = case_when(
      current_status_int >= 80 ~ "Good (80–100)",
      current_status_int >= 60 ~ "Moderate (60–79)",
      current_status_int >= 40 ~ "Fair (40–59)",
      is.na(current_status_int) ~ "No data",
      TRUE ~ "Poor (0–39)"
    )
  )

# Join onto OHI polygons
ohi_coral_condition <- ohi_regions %>%
  left_join(coral_condition_map, by = "rgn_id")

# Split marine vs land
ohi_marine <- ohi_coral_condition %>% filter(location == "marine")
ohi_land   <- ohi_coral_condition %>% filter(location == "land")

# Custom colors
status_colors <- c(
  "Good (80–100)" = "#1a9850",      # green
  "Moderate (60–79)" = "#fee08b",  # yellow
  "Fair (40–59)" = "#fdae61",      # orange
  "Poor (0–39)" = "#d73027",        # red
  "No data" = "darkgrey" # grey
)

# Plot
tmap_mode("plot")

tm_shape(ohi_land) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "#f5e6c8",
    border.col = "gray40",
    lwd = 1,
    alpha = 0.5,
    legend.show = FALSE
  ) +

tm_shape(ohi_marine) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "status_cat",
    palette = status_colors,
    alpha = 0.85,
    title = "Coral Current Status (2024)",
    border.col = "black",
    lwd = 1.2
  ) +

tm_layout(
  title = "Coral Current Status (2024)",
  frame = FALSE,
  legend.outside = TRUE
)

```


# STEP 4: ESTIMATE CORL_Pressure, the inverse of CORL_current_status ------------------------------

```{r Estimate pressure as 100 minus current status}
CORL_Pressure <- CORL_Current_Status %>%
  mutate(pressure = (100 - CORL_current_status) / 100,
         pressure= round(pressure, 2)) %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, pressure)

```

## Save CORL_Pressure
```{r Save CORL_Pressure}
write.csv(CORL_Pressure,
          here::here("_habitats/HAB_corals/CRL_outputs/CORL_Pressure_1.1_Nov062026.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```


# STEP 5: ESTIMATE CORL TREND (source: multiple data sources, 1997-present) ------------------------------

## METHOD A - modified

```{r Calculate CORL_Trend using METHOD A}
colnames(CORL_Current_Status)

# METHOD A - modified:
# See GitHub issue, Oct 7 2026, for more details: https://github.com/OHI-GOC/OHI_GOC_issues/issues/127#issuecomment-6041025924
# slope <- (contemporary_condition - historic_condition) / n_years
# where historic_condition is the midpoint of the HISTORIC period, contemporary_condition is the midpoint of the CONTEMPORARY period, and n_years = years between midpoints
# trend_pct_yr <- (slope / historic_condition) * 100

# Historic midpoint: first and last observed years, 1998–2009
historic_years <- CORL_Current_Status %>%
  filter(
    year < HISTORIC_CUTOFF,
    !is.na(observed_LCC)
  ) %>%
  group_by(rgn_name, rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    historic_midpoint = (min(year) + max(year)) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Contemporary midpoint: first and last observed years, 2010 onward
contemporary_years <- CORL_Current_Status %>%
  filter(
    year >= HISTORIC_CUTOFF,
    !is.na(observed_LCC)
  ) %>%
  group_by(rgn_name, rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    contemporary_midpoint = (min(year) + max(year)) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Retrieve existing means and calculate trend
CORL_Trend0 <- CORL_Current_Status %>%
  group_by(rgn_name, rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    historic_condition = first(historic_mean),
    contemporary_condition = first(contemporary_mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(historic_years, by = c("rgn_name", "rgn_id")) %>%
  inner_join(contemporary_years, by = c("rgn_name", "rgn_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    n_years = contemporary_midpoint - historic_midpoint,
    trend = (contemporary_condition - historic_condition) / n_years
  )

CORL_Trend0
# 2 obs., 8 vars.

```

```{r Clean up trend and save}

colnames(CORL_Trend0)

CORL_Trend<- CORL_Trend0 %>%
    select(
    rgn_name, rgn_id,
    historic_midpoint, contemporary_midpoint, n_years,
    historic_condition, contemporary_condition,
    trend
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    trend_method = "Modified Method A: contemporary midpoint vs. historic midpoint"
  )
  
```


## Save CORL_Trend

```{r Save CORL_Trend}
write.csv(CORL_Trend,
          here::here("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/_habitats/HAB_corals/CRL_outputs/CORL_Trend_1.1_Nov062026.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
# 2 obs., 9 vars.
```
